$comment: Golden scenarios (quickstart section 4). The replay provider picks a scenario by the claim's serial (and tenant) and answers the n-th model call of an agent from tests/fixtures/ai-recordings/{scenarioId}/{agent}-{n}.json.

claim: the ClaimSubmissionData sent to POST /api/public/claims or POST /api/claims, without purchase.date; the purchase date is the claim date plus purchaseDateOffsetMonths (or purchaseDate when a scenario needs an absolute date).
evidence: files under seed/evidence/ (rendered from seed/evidence/evidence.json by tools/Warranty.EvidenceGenerator), uploaded as the invoice part and the photos parts in this order.

references: the run's harness-issued references the fixtures assume. EV-1 is the invoice and EV-2.. the photos in upload order. POL-n are issued for the retrieved clauses of the applicable policy version with Period and Exclusion clauses first in clause-key order, then the other retrieved clauses by score (the top one is the Coverage clause for these scenarios).

Fixture placeholders: {{claim.purchaseDate}} and {{claim.claimDate}} are replaced with the claim's dates (yyyy-MM-dd) when a fixture is replayed, so the invoice date always matches the stated purchase date.

expected: labelled from the tenant's seeded policy text before any model run (research R19), never copied from model output. citedClauseKeys are the clauses the recommendation cites as SUPPORTS_COVERAGE, SUPPORTS_REJECTION or DEFINES_PERIOD.

scenarios.title: Aurora AUR-TAB10 that will not power on, bought 4 months ago in North America; consistent invoice and photos

claim.problemDescription: My Aurora Tab 10 suddenly stopped turning on. The screen stays black, it does not react to the power button and there is no charging light when I plug it in. It was never dropped and never got wet.

scenarios.title: Same as S1 but bought 18 months ago in North America: the 12-month warranty period has ended

claim.problemDescription: The tablet will not power on anymore. Nothing happens when I press the power button or connect the charger, the screen just stays black. It has not been dropped or exposed to water.
